name: K-12 School / School District
description: Organization structure for a K-12 school district or individual school. Covers governance through the school board, district-level administration, school-site leadership, instructional staff by grade and subject, student support services, and operations including facilities, cafeteria, and transportation. Designed for public, private, and charter school settings serving approximately 500-5,000 students across multiple grade bands.

org_structure.overview: K-12 schools operate under a governance model where an elected or appointed school board sets policy and a Superintendent (district) or Head of School (single site) executes. The organization is split into instructional delivery (teaching and learning), student support services (counseling, special education, health), and operations (facilities, transportation, food service). School-site leadership follows a Principal-to-teacher reporting structure with department or grade-level leads coordinating curriculum. Compliance with state/national education standards is a cross-cutting concern. Budget authority flows from the board through the Superintendent, with school-site budgets managed by Principals.

departments.name: School Board / Board of Trustees
departments.description: Governing body that sets district policy, approves the budget, hires/evaluates the Superintendent, and represents the community. Meets publicly on a regular cadence. Not involved in daily operations.

roles.title: Board Chair
roles.description: Presides over board meetings, sets agenda with Superintendent, signs official documents.

roles.title: Board Member
roles.description: Votes on policy, budget, and personnel decisions; serves on committees.

departments.name: Superintendent's Office / Central Administration
departments.description: District-level executive leadership responsible for strategic direction, finance, HR, curriculum standards, and community relations. Sets the vision aligned to board policy and state requirements.

roles.title: Superintendent / Head of School
roles.description: Chief executive of the district or school. Oversees all operations, instructional quality, and strategic planning.

roles.title: Deputy Superintendent
roles.description: Deputy responsible for day-to-day operations and board relations. Acts as Superintendent in their absence.

roles.title: Chief Financial Officer / Business Manager
roles.description: Manages district budget, payroll, procurement, and financial reporting to the board and state.

roles.title: Director of Human Resources
roles.description: Oversees hiring, licensure compliance, employee relations, benefits, and professional development.

roles.title: Director of Communications
roles.description: Manages district messaging, crisis communication, website, social media, and media relations.

departments.name: Curriculum & Instruction
departments.description: Sets academic standards, selects curricula and textbooks, provides professional development, and oversees assessment programs. Ensures alignment with state/national standards.

roles.title: Director of Curriculum & Instruction
roles.description: Leads curriculum adoption, instructional frameworks, and professional development strategy.

roles.title: Instructional Coach
roles.description: Provides in-class coaching, modeling lessons, and data-driven support to teachers.

roles.title: Assessment Coordinator
roles.description: Manages standardized testing logistics, data analysis, and reporting.

departments.name: Student Services & Special Education
departments.description: Ensures compliance with IDEA/Equity Act and provides specialized instruction, accommodations, and related services for students with disabilities. Also oversees counseling, health services, and 504 plans.

roles.title: Director of Student Services / Special Education
roles.description: Oversees special education compliance, IEP processes, and student support programs.

roles.title: Special Education Teacher
roles.description: Provides specialized instruction per IEPs; co-teaches or runs resource rooms.

roles.title: School Psychologist
roles.description: Conducts psycho-educational evaluations, counsels students, consults on behavior plans.

roles.title: Speech-Language Pathologist
roles.description: Assesses and treats speech/language disorders as part of special education services.

roles.title: Occupational Therapist
roles.description: Provides fine-motor and sensory integration therapy for students with disabilities.

roles.title: School Counselor
roles.description: Provides academic, career, and social-emotional counseling to students.

roles.title: School Nurse
roles.description: Manages student health records, medication administration, and emergency care.

departments.name: School Site – Elementary (Grades K-5)
departments.description: School-level instructional delivery for primary grades. Self-contained classrooms with one teacher covering most subjects per class. Specialists for art, music, and PE.

roles.title: Principal
roles.description: Instructional leader of the school. Manages staff, budget, discipline, parent relations, and school culture.

roles.title: Assistant Principal
roles.description: Supports principal with discipline, scheduling, teacher evaluation, and operations.

roles.title: Classroom Teacher (K-5)
roles.description: Teaches all core subjects to a self-contained class of 20-30 students.

roles.title: Specialist Teacher (Art/Music/PE)
roles.description: Provides specialized instruction in art, music, or physical education across grade levels.

roles.title: Instructional Aide / Paraprofessional
roles.description: Supports classroom teachers with small-group instruction, supervision, and clerical tasks.

departments.name: School Site – Secondary (Grades 6-12)
departments.description: School-level instructional delivery for middle and high school. Department-based subject matter instruction. Includes elective programs, advanced placement, and extracurricular oversight.

roles.title: Principal
roles.description: Instructional leader of the secondary school. Manages staff, budget, discipline, scheduling, and school culture.

roles.title: Assistant Principal
roles.description: Oversees grade-level teams, discipline, attendance, and operations.

roles.title: Department Chair
roles.description: Leads a subject department (Math, Science, English, Social Studies, etc.) and mentors department teachers.

roles.title: Subject Teacher
roles.description: Teaches subject-specific courses across grade levels; may teach AP/IB/Honors sections.

roles.title: Elective / CTE Teacher
roles.description: Teaches career and technical education, STEM electives, or fine arts.

roles.title: Athletic Director
roles.description: Manages school sports programs, scheduling, coaching staff, and compliance.

departments.name: Operations & Facilities
departments.description: Manages the physical plant, custodial services, maintenance, transportation fleet, food service, and safety/security. Ensures safe, clean learning environments.

roles.title: Director of Operations / Facilities
roles.description: Oversees all facilities, maintenance, custodial, and safety operations across the district.

roles.title: Custodial / Maintenance Staff
roles.description: Cleans and maintains school buildings and grounds; performs minor repairs.

roles.title: Transportation Director / Fleet Manager
roles.description: Manages bus routes, fleet maintenance, driver hiring/training, and compliance.

roles.title: Bus Driver
roles.description: Drives scheduled bus routes and field trips; ensures student safety during transport.

roles.title: Food Service Manager
roles.description: Manages school meal programs, menu planning, nutrition compliance, and kitchen staff.

roles.title: Kitchen / Cafeteria Staff
roles.description: Prepares and serves meals; maintains kitchen sanitation and inventory.

departments.name: Technology
departments.description: Supports instructional and administrative technology including network infrastructure, device management (1:1 programs), learning management systems, and IT help desk.

roles.title: Director of Technology
roles.description: Leads IT strategy, infrastructure, security, and educational technology integration.

roles.title: IT Support Specialist
roles.description: Provides help desk support, device deployment and repair, and network maintenance.

roles.title: EdTech / Instructional Technology Coach
roles.description: Trains teachers on technology integration tools, LMS administration, and digital citizenship.

key_relationships: School Board hires, evaluates, and can terminate the Superintendent; the Superintendent implements board policy and advises the board.
Principals report to the Superintendent (or Deputy) and are the primary link between central administration and school-site staff.
Director of Student Services coordinates closely with Principals to place and support students with IEPs at school sites.
Curriculum & Instruction team provides professional development and instructional materials that teachers implement in the classroom.
Operations supports all school sites with transportation, meals, and facility maintenance; Principals communicate site-level needs to Operations.
Technology provides devices, infrastructure, and LMS support to all instructional staff and administrators.
School Counselors support both students and teachers and report to Student Services while embedded at school sites.
Grade-level or department teams within each school coordinate horizontally on instruction, assessment, and student progress.
State education agency and accrediting bodies set standards that the district must meet; the Director of Curriculum & Instruction leads compliance efforts.
Parent-Teacher Organizations (PTO/PTA) and site councils provide community input to Principals and the Board.
